response.sql:
WITH operator_stats AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats
),
qualifying_operators AS (
  SELECT os.scan_count, os.avg_gb_per_min, ao.avg_gb_per_min AS all_avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats os
  CROSS JOIN all_operator_avg ao
  WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > ao.avg_gb_per_min
)
SELECT
  AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scans_per_operator,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min - all_avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_excess_gb_per_min
FROM qualifying_operators;

assumptions.assumption: The all-operator figure and the qualifying operators’ average rate give each operator equal weight by averaging operator-level scan rates. Scan counts include all scans by each qualifying operator, even scans with missing rate inputs; NULL rates and zero-minute durations are excluded from rate averages.

alternatives.interpretation: If “how many scans” means only scans with both file size and a nonzero duration, count only those rate-eligible scans per qualifying operator.

WITH operator_stats AS (
  SELECT
    crewref,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0) AS scan_count,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats
),
qualifying_operators AS (
  SELECT os.scan_count, os.avg_gb_per_min, ao.avg_gb_per_min AS all_avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats os
  CROSS JOIN all_operator_avg ao
  WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > ao.avg_gb_per_min
)
SELECT
  AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scans_per_operator,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min - all_avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_excess_gb_per_min
FROM qualifying_operators;
